description:
After many years in film production, I decided to pursue a new direction and am now looking for exciting challenges and innovative projects in IT. Today, I use code to write my own “screenplays” — with visible results directly on the screen and the goal of creating sustainable solutions that genuinely help people.
I care deeply about finding the right balance between intuitive, visually appealing design and high performance and scalability in my applications. Curiosity and a strong willingness to learn continuously drive me to grow both professionally and personally, so I can become a developer that people and companies can truly rely on.
